executive_summary.primary_bottleneck: High monthly churn (8.5%) and low net revenue retention (88%)
key_findings: CAC $900 vs ACV $2400 yields 4.5‑month payback but is eroded by churn
Limited engineering capacity restricts custom development
executive_summary.strategic_thesis: Implement repeatable, low‑code retention systems that accelerate activation and reinforce value, thereby reducing churn while creating a modest acquisition engine through referrals
executive_summary.primary_30_day_objective: Reduce monthly churn from 8.5% to ≤6% and lift activation rate to at least 30% within 30 days
assumptions: Founder leads sales and can devote 5 h/week to growth initiatives
Team of 3 can manage no‑code tools and basic analytics
Monthly marketing budget of $3,000 is fully available for tool subscriptions and incentives

prioritized_growth_channels.rationale: Directly guides new users to first value, addressing the activation gap that drives churn
supporting_evidence: Monthly churn 8.5% indicates users are not reaching value early
Current activation estimated ~20% based on usage data
prioritized_growth_channels.system_to_build: Multi‑step email sequence (welcome, first‑value, best‑practice) triggered on signup via a no‑code email platform
prioritized_growth_channels.target: Increase activation from ~20% to ≥30% in 30 days
risks: Low open/click rates may limit impact

prioritized_growth_channels.rationale: Provides real‑time assistance, shortening time‑to‑value and lowering early churn
supporting_evidence: User feedback shows confusion with core features
Churn spikes after first week of usage
prioritized_growth_channels.system_to_build: Configurable guided tour and contextual tooltips using a no‑code overlay tool (e.g., Appcues)
prioritized_growth_channels.target: Raise adoption from 35% to 50% of active users in 30 days
risks: Tour may be perceived as intrusive

prioritized_growth_channels.rationale: Leverages satisfied customers to generate qualified leads and reinforces loyalty, modestly expanding the funnel without heavy spend
supporting_evidence: High ACV $2,400 indicates strong revenue per retained customer
Net revenue retention 88% shows room to grow within existing base
prioritized_growth_channels.system_to_build: Referral portal with automated reward distribution (credits or feature add‑ons) built with a low‑code form tool
prioritized_growth_channels.leading_kpi: Referral conversion rate (referrals becoming paying customers)
prioritized_growth_channels.target: Generate at least 5 qualified referrals in the 30‑day window
risks: Reward cost could outweigh revenue if not calibrated
Tracking referrals may require manual reconciliation

action_plan_30_days.objective: Map churn drivers and establish baseline metrics

actions.task: Conduct churn interviews with 5 recently lost customers
actions.success_metric: Interview notes completed for all 5 customers

actions.task: Create detailed user‑journey funnel and identify drop‑off points
actions.success_metric: Funnel diagram with at least 3 key drop‑off stages

action_plan_30_days.objective: Develop the three retention systems and required assets

actions.task: Design and implement the automated onboarding email sequence in Mailchimp
actions.success_metric: Sequence live and triggered for new sign‑ups

actions.task: Configure in‑app guided tour using Appcues (or equivalent)
actions.success_metric: Tour published and visible to users

actions.task: Create referral program landing page and reward structure
actions.success_metric: Referral page live with clear CTA

action_plan_30_days.objective: Activate systems for a test segment and collect early indicators

actions.task: Enroll first 20 new users into the email nurture sequence
Roll out guided tour to 100 active users
actions.success_metric: Tour completion recorded for ≥70% of target users

actions.task: Send referral invitation emails to top 10 existing customers

action_plan_30_days.objective: Analyze results, optimize, and document SOPs for ongoing execution

actions.task: Optimize email sequence based on open/click data
Document SOPs for email nurture, in‑app tour, and referral program
actions.success_metric: SOP documents approved and stored in shared drive
